title: DeadyPooly
description: Become Dead Pool, interact with Dead Pool breaking the 4th wall
body:
**DeadyPooly**

![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/571bcd8b52db27cb6ed64a489b046c593b1f5b32.png)

DeadyPooly brings a fast, flashy, Deadpool-inspired experience to Minecraft. Suit up in the full DeadyPooly armor set, slice through enemies with a custom katana, fire an animated pistol, and decorate your house with the Dead Pool Pop block.

The mod adds custom models, item visuals, red-themed durability bars, combat particles, a back katana render, and an in-game config menu so you can tweak the experience your way.

Dead Pool might break the 4th Wall popping up on your screen with Voice lines
(Most of them happen when the FULL set is equiped)

_Wearing the full Set gives you Speed and also Regen when getting Damaged_

**Features**
- Full DeadyPooly armor set
- Custom katana and pistol
- Back katana visual when carried
- Dead Pool breaking the 4th wall...
- Dead Pool Pop decoration block
- Red/dark durability bars
- Recipes, repair materials, and commands
- In-game config menu
